tools.name: get_supported
tools.description: Returns the payment networks, schemes, assets, and facilitator addresses currently supported by PayAI. Use it before constructing payment requirements when you need live capability data.

tools.name: verify_payment
tools.description: Verifies a signed x402 payment payload against the supplied payment requirements. It checks validity but moves no funds.

tools.name: settle_payment
tools.description: Broadcasts the payment on-chain and moves real funds; it is idempotent per signed payload, so resubmitting the identical payload returns the recorded outcome. Treat errorReason "settlement_pending" as unresolved and call again with the identical arguments to poll.

tools.name: list_discovery_resources
tools.description: Lists x402-payable resources published in the PayAI Bazaar catalog. Use limit and offset to page through APIs, MCP tools, and agent services available for discovery.

tools.name: get_discovery_stats
tools.description: Returns aggregate statistics for the PayAI Bazaar catalog and its settlement activity. Use it for a compact view of catalog size and payment volume rather than individual resources.
